t: The Context King's Blueprint: Building a Local AI Operating System
s: Pipulate is a local-first, AI-orchestrated OS for building a Sovereign Intelligence Engine. It addresses LLM statelessness and amnesia through explicit context management, WET workflows, and radical transparency, enabling a "Forever Machine" where human continuity drives AI actuation.
sub: Pipulate: A Local-First Sovereign Intelligence Engine
Overcoming LLM Amnesia and Statelessness via Explicit Context
The "Forever Machine": Checkpointed Reality & AI-on-Rails Workflows
